_comment: Copy to DIRECTOR/director_work.json. schema_version: the config format; tools refuse a version they do not know. window: 100000-1000000. plugins_off: only user-installed plugins, as name@marketplace, after the PO ticked them. backup_dir: null = inside the repo's .git folder. skip_worktrees: path substrings to leave alone. hooks: true adds the hook_guard.py PreToolUse hook. protect_director (optional): the DIRECTOR folder; the hook then also blocks Write / Edit on its orders/ and DIRECTOR_LOG.md (implies hooks). director_worktree (optional): the Director's own worktree, which keeps the plain hook.trace_id_pattern (optional): regex for the requirement or decision IDs that orders list in TRACES_TO; trace_report.py flags IDs that do not fit. Use the project's own IDs. mode (optional): general or beginner, picked right after the starting prompt (docs/12); tools do not read it. po_pending_files / po_item_pattern / po_open_pattern (optional): where metrics_report.py counts PO entries; the defaults read PO_PENDING.md entries `ID: OD-..` / `ID: ACT-..` with `STATUS: open`.
